subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should plugin Control UI pages ship as a separate `registerControlUiEntryPoint`/Gateway RPC contract, or should launch/session behavior be folded into the existing `surface: "tab"` Control UI descriptor seam with fixed sandboxing?
rationale: This is a durable public plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser trust-boundary choice; automation can identify unsafe paths, but maintainers need to choose the permanent API shape before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor with scoped launch/session behavior, keep plugin pages iframe-only, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require maintainer-approved top-level mode semantics, fixed sandbox rules, fail-closed launch handling, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open but do not merge until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 settle native plugin page semantics.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor with scoped launch/session behavior, keep plugin pages iframe-only, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the host-hook foundation and adjacent contribution-slot RFC, so their history best matches the API-shape decision.
